objective: Split a meaningful request into safe parallel lanes without creating file conflicts or hidden dependencies.

tasks.title: Collect source evidence
tasks.scope: Web search, repository search, source ranking, and reusable research capture.
verification_steps: Run or simulate hallucination-guard-agent for material source claims.
tasks.notes: Research can usually run beside implementation only when implementation does not depend on research results.

tasks.title: Implement scoped code or configuration changes
tasks.scope: Source, tests, and deterministic config updates for one capability.
verification_steps: Run targeted and full tests before merge.
tasks.notes: Implementation lanes must not touch the same files as another active lane unless serialized.

tasks.title: Document workflow and history
tasks.scope: Docs, prompts, workflows, requirements, specs, and history backfill.
verification_steps: Run workspace index and task board checks.
tasks.notes: Docs can run in parallel only after the shape of implementation is stable or if docs touch independent files.

conflict_controls: Every lane records touch_paths before execution.
Tasks with overlapping touch_paths must be serialized through dependencies or a named lock.
Only the primary agent commits and pushes after final merge verification unless a separate branch/worktree policy is documented.
merge_strategy: Merge each lane after its own verification passes, then run full final checks from the primary workspace before commit.
communication_checkpoints: Update coordination status when a lane starts, blocks, finishes, or changes touch_paths.
Stop and re-plan when a lane discovers it needs files owned by another lane.
verification_steps: Run full final tests/checks after merging all lane outputs.
rollback_plan: Keep lane outputs attributable by task_id.
If one lane fails, do not revert unrelated completed lanes.
Re-plan dependencies before retrying the failed lane.
source_value_provenance: dependency, touch path, ownership, and conflict assumptions <- repository map, git status, project registry, and checked workflow docs
plan_evidence: parallel batch choice <- tasks with no dependency edge and no overlapping touch_paths
serialization choice <- dependency edge, shared touch_path, shared mutable resource, or verification dependency
